title: Update - live testing nominal stakes  - 1 hour BTC - refined ago - 48% win rate - 44 trades thus far - profitability 90%! No joke - trade log included.
author: Four_0_one_k

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: you're the one with the hourly BTC model, good to see you froze it and went small before scaling. 44 trades is still a short sample though. what does the worst losing streak in that log look like so far?

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body:
9 in a row.... which is statistically unbelievable, but it was one consistent market condition over 24 hours with a preventable repeated bad set up for my model. My impulse was to adjust it again to avoid it the same situation on further live testing, but it's frozen so keeping it pure until I have a few more weeks to work off of. In 2000 trade run, there's only a 10% chance of 10+ losing streak, so this was a unique scenario that's solvable. 

|Longest losing streak in a typical run (same trades for both)|11 in a row · 1 in 10 runs sees 14+|
|:-|:-|

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: 11 as the typical worst case is a useful number to have written down before going live. if it hits 14+ in the next few weeks I'd stop calling it a one off. good that you froze it instead of patching after one bad day.

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: Appreciate your insight. I'll keep you posted with updates.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: please do. the first losing streak after the freeze will tell you more than the 44 trades before it did.

comments.author: ConversationAgile73
comments.body: are you gonna drop the app?

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: Certainly not with the mechanics of the bot still in, but I can strip my Kalshi key, and share the UI if you're interested.

replies.author: Four_0_one_k
replies.body: After testing lots of different setups, the most successful version used VWMA as the primary indicator and places position in the closet tranche >$100 OTM.
